'''Galactic Alliance Starfighter Command''' was a military unit within the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]]. It was commanded by the [[Chief of Starfighter Command (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of Starfighter Command]]. After the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], several high-ranking Galactic Alliance [[Officer/Legends|officers]] had to be replaced, allowing [[General/Legends|General]] [[Merratt Jaxton]] to rise to this rank. He remained in this position in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]].
